items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: I believe I can get that done. I played with him on the Battle House.

ctx.x: And what tunes did Barrel House sing himself to you? Do you remember any of them?

Well, he the guy used to sing that song about, I got a nipple, you got a dime, let's get together and buy some wine. Shake Shake Babe. That's the piece he used to play. Well why don't you play a couple of them? Shake Shake Babe, I'm going to buy you a diamond ring. If you don't Shake Shake Babe I ain't going to buy you a doggone thing. I believe I can get that done. I played with him on the Battle House. I'm going to buy you a diamond ring. Let's get together and buy some wine. Shake Shake Babe. I've got a nickel…

Yeah, that's one of the numbers. That's one of the barrel ounces numbers. That's right, that's him. Well, let's do a little talking, because I think all we got's just time enough for that. What kind of chords do you play? Do you know the names of your chords? The chords?
